title: Robot Watering Memory Flowers
description: A large teal robot with a grinning face and gear-adorned head stands in a surreal cityscape, watering framed portraits growing like flowers on vines with a watering can. Three women in patterned dresses walk along a path holding lanterns in the foreground, beneath a vibrant orange and teal sky with floating gears, bubbles, and a palm tree sprouting from the robot.
prompt: A giant smiling teal robot with exposed gears and roots stands in a surreal nighttime city, using a watering can to pour liquid onto framed portraits that grow like flowers on vines. Three silhouetted women in colorful patterned dresses walk along a glowing path holding lanterns. Palm tree grows from the robot's head, bubbles and mechanical gears float in the vibrant orange and teal sky, psychedelic folk art style with bold outlines.
